summary: A web app to upload personal memories (photos/content) and publish them so they can be shared via a public link accessible by anyone.
known_issues: Internal AI system error occurred during build/deploy; user requested retry.

existing_features.title: Add frontend UI for signed-in users to publish/unpublish their memories and copy a shareable link that can be opened by anyone to view the published memories.
Add a public “shared memories” viewing mode in the frontend that detects a share identifier/token in the URL and shows the published memories without requiring Internet Identity sign-in.

new_feature_requests.summary: Allow users to upload memories (e.g., photos/content) and publish them to a shareable public link accessible by anyone.
Add backend support for publishing a user’s uploaded memories to a shareable public link so that anyone (including unauthenticated visitors) can view the published memories.

Update backend access control so private memories remain accessible only to the owner (as today), while published memories are accessible only through the new public-share query APIs and only when the owner has explicitly enabled publishing.
If the backend needs new persistent state to support publishing/share links, add a conditional Motoko migration to preserve existing canister data across upgrade.

projectName: Publish memories via shareable public link
